preformal_storage_addendum.reason: Available workspace disk space cannot retain every uncompressed 100k/200k-stage database concurrently.
preformal_storage_addendum.semantics: Only snapshot storage changes. Workload, original source bytes, queries, gold, budgets, arm order, API timing boundaries and scoring stay unchanged.
preformal_storage_addendum.integrity: Bind compressed artifact hash/size and original SQLite hash/size; reopen completed gzip and authenticate the full stream before deleting raw; restore exact bytes before every worker and offline source audit.
preformal_storage_addendum.resource_policy: Keep a 1000000000-byte free-space floor. Check full raw restoration headroom before writing, and enforce the floor during compression, restoration and ingestion. Stop safely and retain evidence on resource failure.
preformal_storage_addendum.prior_protocol: The complete pre-addendum source bytes are preserved in the continuation evidence; early smoke measurements retain their original bindings.

claims: Synthetic scale plus authored transfer development evidence; no heldout real-project or LLM-task claim.
controls: same logical corpus interleaved physical layout
unrelated source write then old-project revalidation
first request after opening each worker
separate parent and cached project-connection SQLite VM work diagnostics
optional explicit required-field false-rejection and missing-evidence diagnostics
timing_boundary: Only public API invocation. Database restore, opening, mutation preparation, scoring and journaling are outside API latency; opening and mutations retained separately.
work_diagnostic_boundary: Separate steady-state calls with sqlite3 progress_handler every 100 VM operations on the parent and every cached project-local connection. First projection building is measured by first-request latency separately. FTS internal C operations and filesystem traffic are not counted.
notes: Four alternating AB/BA rounds; 16 cold and 32 warm samples per recall query and arm per stage.
Optional expanded profile adds foreign growth to more than 200000 actual pages; never label it executed unless manifest completed.
No changed query, expected answer, budget or order may erase a measured failure.
Source and evaluator byte identities bind every worker before and after execution.
